lede: The biggest thing to watch this week is Telluride Town Council's Tuesday meeting, where a public hearing on a development vesting extension is on the formal agenda and a work session on automated license plate reader cameras — the Flock Safety system — opens the morning. Across the region, San Miguel County's Planning Commission spends most of October 8 on an Affordable Housing Code Update in a joint session with the BOCC, and Ouray County kicks off its own consequential week with a joint City-County work session on a proposed intergovernmental agreement that would shift full law enforcement for the City of Ouray to the County starting January 2027.

notable.stake: County could absorb city policing under a new IGA starting Jan. 2027.
